description.value: Hatley Park gardens is a National Historic Site on the 260-hectare Royal Roads University campus, featuring manicured Italian, Japanese, and rose gardens surrounding the iconic Hatley Castle, built for a Vancouver Island coal baron. The estate includes walking, hiking, and biking trails with sweeping views of the Strait of Juan de Fuca and the Olympic Mountains. Free public access to the formal gardens makes it an accessible and scenic destination for touring cyclists exploring Greater Victoria.
